subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: What public sub-agent completion-announcement control should OpenClaw support for the deterministic skip case?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but adding a public tool/config surface overlaps global suppression, per-spawn overrides, per-channel policy, and broader parent-session routing; automation should not choose that product contract alone.

options.title: Unified announce policy
options.body: Add one opt-in policy surface that preserves current behavior while supporting deterministic skip and leaves room for parent or per-channel routing semantics.

options.title: Per-spawn skip only
options.body: Add only a `sessions_spawn` skip flag, minimizing config blast radius but leaving repeated boilerplate and channel defaults for later work.

options.title: Defer to routing design
options.body: Hold this issue behind the broader announceTarget/per-channel design to avoid duplicate API surface, at the cost of continued workarounds.

recommendation.title: Unified announce policy
recommendation.body: Add one opt-in policy surface that preserves current behavior while supporting deterministic skip and leaves room for parent or per-channel routing semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history across `sessions_spawn`, subagent announce delivery, docs, and prior maintainer-facing review of this exact decision.
